system.summary: Swedish homophonic nomenclator of about 810 numbers in alphabetical order: letters in two series (1-99), syllable blocks by fives (85-227), words and names (400-810), nulls 3 and 82; clear words interspersed

prior_solution.where: L1 and L2 carry a decipherment and a gloss of the time (images 293, 295-297); Uddgren 1950 quotes the orders of 21 Jan and 19 Feb 1706 in clear from the Riksregistraturet. No clear text of 21 Feb (L3) or 2 Mar 1706 (L4) found; the Riksregistraturet was not consulted.

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout chose the target and set the rules (held-out portion and key frozen by SHA-256 before one measurement, burned portions, strict word count); he decided to file the v2 result with its lowered threshold stated (not validated at the programme's bar). AI agents transcribed, rebuilt the key, measured, read and wrote up.
models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agents run by Brice Dudout

solution.what: L1 (3 copies), L2 (295-297) and L4 transcribed from the TIFF; L4 in two passes; the decipherment of the time on 293 transcribed.
Copies of L1 aligned with the decipherment of the time (293) and L2 with its interlinear gloss; key K, 176 codes, frozen.
v1: one pre-registered measurement on the held-out L4 (292 groups) by lexical coverage: S 0.723 against permuted keys max 0.790; thresholds 0.85 and max + 0.30 not reached. L4 burned.
Key K2 (218 codes) fitted on L1, L2, 297 and the burned L4, using the alphabetical blocks of the nomenclator; L3 transcribed (two copies) and frozen before any key change.

v2: one pre-registered measurement on the held-out L3 (780 groups), letter 5-gram score N: 0.695 against 200 permuted keys mean 0.057, max 0.294. Thresholds declared before: 0.60 (lowered from the default 0.85, with calibration) and max + 0.30. Passes the declared thresholds, not the programme's 0.85: not validated at the programme's bar. The metric (letter 5-gram score) and the 0.60 threshold were chosen after the v1 measurement had failed and after K2's decodes of its own fitting letters (0.68-0.88) had been seen; they were then written into protocol/PREREG-v2.md, which was hashed before the one measurement on L3 (protocol/PREREG-v2.sha256, 16cd4155...).
Key K3 (244 codes) extended after the measurement; L3 and L4 read in part (sure + probable 83% and 79% of words).
Carlson 1893, Uddgren 1950, SBL, repository catalogue and leads; stade1710 key compared (0 of 131 shared codes agree). Riksregistraturet not reached (anti-robot check).

Letter 108 (Altranstädt, 5 Jan 1707, images 366-367) carries a word-by-word interlinear gloss of the time; its groups and glosses transcribed (transcription/L108_5jan1707_366_367_gloss.txt) and a table T108 built from the glosses alone (101 codes, 94 sure, 7 doubtful), frozen by SHA-256 (protocol/FROZEN-v3.sha256). Of the 86 codes T108 shares with K3, 80 agree; the 6 others differ in spelling only (23 m/mm, 36 s/ß, 225 wij/wi, 556 hafwe/hafwer, 669 til/till, 10 ch/x?). T108 gives 520 eller, 544 fram, 557 han, 629 parti, which were open in K3.

v3: one pre-registered measurement (protocol/PREREG-v3-letter119.md) of T108 alone on letter 119 (Altranstädt, 30 Apr 1707, images 397, 399, 400; 421 groups, transcription frozen before decoding): words read with T108, sure + probable P = 0.434 (50 sure, 16 probable, 64 supplied, 22 unread of 152) against the threshold 0.60 fixed beforehand: failed. Letter 119 uses mostly homophones that do not occur in 108 (39 a, 108 t, 59 n, 67 r, 47 e, 125 de, 53 i, 68 s). Letter 119 is burned.

Key K4 (key/key_K4_with_gloss108.json, 256 codes) = K3 + 12 sure values of T108; decryptions regenerated. L3 gains 4 sure words (520 eller twice, 557 han, 629 parti), L4 gains 4 (629 parti / partiet three times, 544 fram). Sure words, measured on our copy: L3 238 of 323 (73.7%), L4 94 of 123 (76.4%). Still read in part.

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: Key rebuilt from the decipherment of the time of L1 and the interlinear gloss of L2 in the same volume, then applied to L3 and L4, which have none.
outcome.fraction_read_source: readings/L3_21feb1706_reading_sv.txt and readings/L4_2mar1706_reading_sv.txt, counted mechanically on our copy (18 Nov 2026): sure words only, over cipher words (README rule of 16 Nov 2026, PR #728): 332 of 446 (L3 238 of 323, L4 94 of 123). Probable, supplied and unread words are holes. Sure + probable would be 373 of 446 (83.6%). Cipher groups given a value by K4: 1,031 of 1,072.

texts.label: Charles XII to Lewenhaupt, Saludek, 21 Feb 1706 (images 301-303)
texts.summary: The king answers Lewenhaupt's letters on the disorder in Livonia: if the Muscovites leave Courland and Samogitia, Lewenhaupt is to march into Courland with his troops and battalions of the Riga and Pernau garrisons; the Riga magazine will not last; Grodno has been passed and part of the enemy shut in; a detachment is to drive the enemy out of Samogitia.

reading_review.note: Sure words join the clear text into Swedish sentences; 54 of 323 words unread, mostly in passage 3; part of passage 2 recalls the 21 Jan letter, which has a decipherment of the time.

texts.label: Charles XII to Lewenhaupt, 2 Mar 1706 (images 310-311)
texts.summary: A detachment sent towards Sadowa has found the enemy; Russian artillery with Wiśniowiecki, Ogiński and the Lithuanian troops; a march towards Vilna that could not catch the enemy; Lewenhaupt is expected to be on the march towards Lithuania.

reading_review.note: Single copy, no gloss; 26 of 123 words unread, the middle sentence is the weakest.

outcome.notes: Not validated at the programme's bar: the measured check (v2) passed an absolute threshold of 0.60, not the programme's 0.85. The metric (letter 5-gram score) and the 0.60 threshold were chosen after the v1 measurement had failed and after K2's decodes of its own fitting letters (0.68-0.88) had been seen; they were then written into protocol/PREREG-v2.md, which was hashed before the one measurement on L3 (protocol/PREREG-v2.sha256, 16cd4155...). protocol/PREREG-v2.part1.sha256 (4ed5060f...) covers an earlier text of that file, not the filed one. The earlier measurement (v1, another letter, another metric) failed. docs/_validate.py could not run on 17 Nov 2026 (sv-gutenberg download HTTP 503); validation.tsv is filed. 18 Nov 2026: the gloss of the time of letter 108 confirms 80 key values and gives 520, 544, 557, 629 (key K4); the pre-registered measurement on letter 119 failed (0.434 < 0.60).
